charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1101_100_:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] spotted
Harmony on a street corner, having just
finished a battle.
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_100_:
Oh, [Name:PlayerNickname ]! Fancy
meeting you in a place like this!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_200_:
I was just battling Team Break a moment
ago. They were stirring up trouble in town!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_300_:
Some nearby Pasio Trainers and I
steamrolled them!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_400_: Feraligatr did her best—and Mega Evolved!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_500_:
But she can’t stay Mega Evolved the whole
battle...
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_600_:
so I try to figure out the perfect moment
to use it!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_700_:
Plus, when Feraligatr Mega Evolves,
her body temperature rises a lot.
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_800_:
That’s why we’re taking a breather—so
Feraligatr can cool off and release heat from
her dorsal fin!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_0401_100_:
Thanks! When people are thoughtful of me
like that, all my fatigue disappears!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_0402_100_:
Ahaha! Looks like Feraligatr’s happy to be
complimented!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_900_:
I experienced all sorts of things in Lumiose,
but it was originally meant to be a vacation.
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_1000:
After meeting Urbain and the others, battling
in the Z-A Royale, and interacting with the
city’s people...
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_1100:
I started thinking I’d like to get stronger—for
the city, the people, and Pokémon.
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_1200: It hasn’t been long since I arrived on Pasio.
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_1300:
But after a lot of sightseeing, I’ve come to
love it here!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_1400:
Lumiose City and Pasio are both wonderful
places where people and Pokémon can live
together in harmony.
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_1500:
They’re both equally precious to me—and
both places I want to protect!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_1600: All right! Looks like Feraligatr’s rested up!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_1700: I guess we’ll get back to our walk.
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_1800:
I thought I’d explore some places I haven’t
been yet. You should come with,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_1900:
If we find a nice café, we can take a break
together!
charaepi_ch0366_00_zagirl/2301_1201_2000:
And take photos with our Pokémon!
It’ll be fun!
